name: markdownify
displayName: Markdownify — Messy Text to Clean Markdown
description: Turn messy text into clean Markdown in one click: AI output, web clips, PDF dumps. No account, no API key.

betterMark.format.headingLevel.markdownDescription: Heading level to generate (`#`, `##`...). `0` (default) **infers** the level from headings already present in the selection; if there are none, uses `#`.

betterMark.format.protectBlocks.description: Never alter code blocks, tables, front matter, HTML and blockquotes. Recommended to keep on.

betterMark.level2.inlineCodeTerms.markdownDescription: Level 2A: turn definition labels into inline code (`Concept:` → `` `Concept`: ``).

betterMark.level2.inlineCodeMentions.markdownDescription: Level 2A: wrap files, paths and cited commands in backticks (`npm install` → `` `npm install` ``). **On by default.**

enumDescriptions: Markdownify (recommended) — works with no setup. The key stays on the Markdownify server, never on your machine.
River AI (api.river.ai/v1) — use your own key
Google Gemini (AI Studio) — use your own key
GLM / Zhipu AI — use your own key
Nemotron via NVIDIA NIM — use your own key
betterMark.ai.provider.description: AI provider used by the AI formatting command. The default (proxy) works with no configuration.

betterMark.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model to use. Empty = provider default (e.g. `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`, `deepseek-chat`, `gemini-2.0-flash`).

betterMark.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription: Provider API key. **Prefer the `Markdownify: Set API key` command**, which stores the key in the VS Code encrypted SecretStorage instead of plain text in `settings.json`.

betterMark.ai.baseUrl.description: Alternative base URL (for proxies, gateways or local OpenAI-compatible models). Empty = provider default.

betterMark.ai.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the AI response, in milliseconds.

enumDescriptions: Infers bold, italic and code from the text cues (default).
Only unambiguous patterns: warnings and obvious technical terms.
Adds no emphasis at all; only fixes structure.
betterMark.ai.emphasis.markdownDescription: How much freedom the AI has to infer inline formatting. The text is NEVER rewritten in any mode — validation rejects the response if any word changes.

betterMark.ai.instructions.markdownDescription: Extra instructions for the AI, added to the internal prompt. E.g. `Answer in English and use level 2 headings`.
